question: In which year was the Foreign Exchange Management Act (FEMA) enacted to replace the Foreign Exchange Regulation Act (FERA)?
solution:
The correct answer is **__1999.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **__Important Points__**

 
• **FERA was replaced by FEMA in 1998 by the Government of Atal Bihari Vajpayee.**
 
• **FEMA was passed in the winter session of Parliament on 29th December 1999.**
